styles.name: minimal-saas
styles.label: Minimal SaaS
styles.summary: Clean solo-founder SaaS default with practical hierarchy, quiet surfaces, and low-decoration components.
styles.typographySample: Use system UI, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif.
styles.component: Metric card: label, value, short delta.

styles.name: premium-dashboard
styles.label: Premium Dashboard
styles.summary: Dashboard-first MVP style with stronger density, metrics, cards, tables, and command surfaces.
styles.typographySample: Use Inter-like system sans with tabular numerals for metrics.
styles.component: KPI card: label, value, trend, comparison.

styles.name: bold-founder
styles.label: Bold Founder
styles.summary: High-contrast launch style for marketing-heavy MVPs with decisive type and CTA hierarchy.
styles.typographySample: Use a heavy display face fallback stack: Impact, Arial Black, Inter, system-ui.
styles.component: Hero lockup: large headline, short proof line, primary CTA.

styles.name: warm-editorial
styles.label: Warm Editorial
styles.summary: Softer consultant/service-product style with restrained serif-led hierarchy and warm surfaces.
styles.typographySample: Use Georgia, Charter, or Times New Roman for display; use system sans for UI labels and forms.
styles.component: Editorial hero: serif headline, concise support copy, terracotta CTA.

styles.name: ecommerce-retail
styles.label: E-Commerce Retail
styles.summary: Product-forward storefront style with photography-led cards, a single confident accent for CTA and price, and a sticky cart/checkout rail.
styles.typographySample: Use a clean geometric/grotesque system sans: system-ui, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif.
styles.component: Product card: image, name, price, rating/review count, add-to-cart.

styles.name: fintech-trust
styles.label: Fintech Trust
styles.summary: Trust-forward financial style with dense data surfaces, tabular numerals, a restrained palette, and strong status semantics.
styles.typographySample: Use a precise system sans with tabular numerals enabled everywhere numbers appear: system-ui, Inter, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif.
styles.component: Balance card: account label, balance (tabular), signed trend, last-updated.

styles.name: editorial-content
styles.label: Editorial Content
styles.summary: Reading-first content style with a narrow measure, serif-led hierarchy, warm surfaces, and minimal chrome for articles, blogs, and marketplace listings.
styles.typographySample: Use a readable serif for headings and long-form body (Georgia, Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', Times New Roman, serif); use system sans for UI labels, nav, and forms.
styles.component: Article hero: serif headline, byline, date, lead image with caption.

styles.name: expressive-spectacle
styles.label: Expressive Spectacle
styles.summary: A dark, warm, cinematic style built for a single art-directed motion moment per screen (BK-357). Pair it with a manifest `signature` block; see the design-prototype skill's references/effects/EFFECTS.md.
styles.typographySample: Use a display serif for hero headlines and section titles (Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif) for an editorial, non-templated character; use system sans for UI, body, and data.
styles.component: Signature hero: full-bleed effect (poster-first) + monumental display headline + one primary CTA.
